title: INPC Registers 0.32% Drop in August, Accumulates 3.98% Increase Over 12 Months
seoTitle: INPC Drops 0.32% in Aug, Up 3.98% Over 12 Months
subtitle: Inflation, as measured by the National Consumer Price Index, recedes in August but maintains an accumulated increase over the past year.
excerpt: The National Consumer Price Index (INPC) ended August with a negative change of 0.32%, while showing a 3.98% increase over the past 12 months, according to Agência Brasil data.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Inflation, as measured by the National Consumer Price Index (INPC), which is used for annual wage adjustments, registered a negative change of -0.32% in August.

Over the cumulative 12-month period, the index shows an increase of 3.98%, as released.

These figures reflect consumer price behavior during the analyzed period.

With information from Agência Brasil.
